desc: We're raisin the bar with Raisin Nut Bran cereal. With the unique combination of flavors and textures from sweet covered raisins to crispy flakes and crunchy almonds, this cereal is simply a cut above the rest.
features:
Whole grain first: Approximately 38 g whole grain per serving—helps meet daily intake recommendations 

High fiber content: 7 g dietary fiber per 1‑cup serving (25% DV), supporting satiety & digestive health 

Blend of textures: Crunchy wheat/bran flakes, sweet raisins, crisp almonds—great taste and consistency 

Good source of nutrients: Includes fiber, protein (11 g), iron, calcium, vitamin D, B‑vitamins—fortified for balanced nutrition 

Kosher-certified & ready-to-eat: Convenient breakfast option ideal for milk, yogurt, trail mix, or baking into bars/snacks
ingredients: Whole Grain Wheat, Sugar, Raisins, Almonds, Corn Bran, Corn Syrup, Brown Sugar Syrup, Palm Kernel Oil, Salt, Glycerin, Canola Oil, Molasses, Soy Lecithin, Corn Starch, Vanilla Extract, Natural Flavor, Vitamin E (Mixed Tocopherols) Added to Preserve Freshness, Vitamins and Minerals: Vitamin C (Sodium Ascorbate), Iron and Zinc (Mineral Nutrients), a B Vitamin (Niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (Pyridoxine Hydrochloride), Vitamin B2 (Riboflavin), Vitamin B1 (Thiamin Mononitrate), a B Vitamin (Folic Acid), Vitamin B12.
